answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 31 keys loses far more than 31 single identities would. The trellis graph is rebuilt each epoch, and as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the fable audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the zenith checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. That is 28 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
